selection: First six NSE intraday_1m folders sorted by integer security ID, selected before performance evaluation.
session_rule: Exactly 375 unique minute buckets 09:15..15:29 IST; positive finite valid OHLC, nonnegative volume and positive day volume. Invalid sessions excluded without filling gaps.
vwap: cumsum(((high+low+close)/3)*volume)/cumsum(volume), reset each session; this is the paper's candle approximation.
baseline: At minute t+1 open, target sign of close_t minus VWAP_t. Reverse on completed close crossing VWAP, flatten at last regular candle close. Exact equality or zero cumulative volume means flat.
combination: Same target, except flat unless five-minute return agrees with direction by at least8bps, latest minute return agrees strictly, and five-minute path efficiency>=0.3. Requires six completed candles. This fixed filter is an extension, not the paper.
sizing: Integer shares using available sleeve equity, fully collateralized without leverage, fee allowance included. Positions remain unchanged while target direction unchanged.
costs: research.intraday_lab.costs current frozen NSE cash intraday tariff applied to all historical dates as a stress assumption, not historical contract notes. Slippage adverse on every entry/exit. No spread, quotes, impact or order book available in candles.
interpretation: No pristine holdout claim, no live eligibility. Coverage uses ex-post full-day availability and causes selection bias. Compare fixed primary1bps case, retain all stresses and all six names.
success_criterion: Primary1bps aggregate net positive in later diagnostic, positive in at least4 of6 independent sleeves, and positive in5bps stress. This criterion alone never establishes live tradability.
